name: Trajectory
description: 为非技术专家提供AI模型持续训练的自动化平台,通过收集应用反馈自动重训模型,使其在法律、金融等专业领域持续改进
description_en: Automated AI model training platform for non-technical experts that enables continuous learning by collecting application feedback and retraining models to improve performance in specialized domains like law and finance
why_matters: 解决了当前AI模型无法从错误中自动学习的核心局限,让律师、医生等专业人士能自主改进模型,无需雇佣昂贵的forward-deployed工程师或研发团队。Harvey、Rogo等客户已使用其平台训练开源模型,使其在审查特定法律合同或公司估值等任务上表现更像经验丰富的从业者
why_matters_en: Addresses the critical limitation that current AI models don't learn from mistakes without further training. Enables lawyers, doctors and other specialists to improve models themselves without expensive FDE teams or consultants. Customers like Harvey and Rogo already use it to post-train open source models to perform like experienced professionals on tasks like reviewing specific legal contracts or valuing companies
latest_news: 2026年11月完成4500万美元A轮融资,估值3亿美元,由Sequoia领投,Nvidia、Bessemer Venture Partners和Bain Capital Ventures参与
latest_news_en: Raised $45M Series A at $300M valuation in November 2026, led by Sequoia with participation from Nvidia, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures
source_title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts

evidence.quote: just announced that it raised $45 million in a Series A round at a $300 million valuation, led by Sequoia, with participation from Nvidia, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures
founded about a year ago by three Stanford classmates with experience at Google DeepMind and Apple

Companies like Harvey and Rogo are already using Trajectory's platform to post-train open source models, helping them perform more like experienced lawyers or financial analysts by learning from previous tasks

name: Fal
description: 专注于AI视频、图像和音频模型托管与推理服务的平台，年化收入已超8亿美元，主要服务依赖开源模型的客户
description_en: Platform for hosting and running AI video, image, and audio models, with over $800M in annualized revenue, primarily serving customers relying on open source models
why_matters: 在AI推理服务需求激增的背景下，Fal在半年内估值翻倍至160亿美元，年化收入超8亿美元，显示出开源模型推理市场的强劲增长势头，尽管毛利率仍然较薄
why_matters_en: Amid surging demand for inference services, Fal doubled its valuation to $16B in six months with $800M+ in annualized revenue, demonstrating strong growth in the open source model inference market despite thin gross margins
latest_news: 2026年11月完成13亿美元F轮融资，由Bessemer Venture Partners领投，Nvidia、Sound Ventures和T. Rowe Price参与，估值达160亿美元
latest_news_en: Raised $1.3B Series F in November 2026 led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Nvidia, Sound Ventures, and T. Rowe Price, at $16B valuation
source_title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges

evidence.quote: Fal , a San Francisco-based startup that hosts and runs AI video, image, and audio models, has raised $1.3 billion in its latest funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Nvidia, Sound Ventures, and T. Rowe Price.
Fal surpassed $800 million in annualized revenue earlier this year
Fal was co-founded in 2021 by Burkay Gur, a former Coinbase machine learning leader and Oracle engineer, and Gorkem Yurtseven, who was previously a developer at Amazon.

name: Conductor
description: AI编码平台,允许用户通过在并行工作空间部署多个代理来启动软件项目,代理来自Anthropic和OpenAI等主要实验室
description_en: AI coding platform allowing users to spin up software projects by deploying multiple agents from major labs like Anthropic and OpenAI into parallel workspaces
why_matters: 创新的代理团队协作模式让软件工程师可以在分隔的项目部分上并行工作,成立仅一年多即被Meta收购,将与Meta的超级智能实验室团队合作开发下一代界面
why_matters_en: Innovative agentic team collaboration model enabling software engineers to work on compartmentalized project parts in parallel, acquired by Meta just over a year after founding to work with Meta Superintelligence Labs team on next-generation interfaces
latest_news: 2026年11月被Meta收购,创始人Charlie Holtz表示将与Meta首席AI官Alexandr Wang和产品负责人Nat Friedman合作,计划2027年初推出新产品
latest_news_en: Acquired by Meta in November 2026, with founder Charlie Holtz announcing plans to work with Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang and Head of Product Nat Friedman, teasing something new by early 2027
source_title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor

evidence.quote: On X, Holtz also noted that he was looking forward to working with Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, and Nat Friedman, head of product at the company's Superintelligence Labs. 'They've been on an absolute tear, and I'm convinced MSL has the highest talent density of all the labs,' he added.

Conductor, founded in 2024, only launched its core product just last summer. The company's agentic teams, which can be deployed in the cloud, locally, or via a user's phone, are designed to help software engineers work on separate, compartmentalized parts of a project in concert.
